CrossMux 1.6.4 for Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 3.97 improves OTA post-install confirmation and protects the font cache during firmware writes.

## Devices and installation

- Install over stable OTA from 1.6.3, or flash `1.6.4` from GitHub Releases if you are on an older build.
- The stable channel manifest and firmware remain on `github.com/dezzw/crossmux` releases.
- No change to USB flash layout or partition tables in this release.

## Reading and reliability

- After an OTA install, the running firmware is confirmed when you reach any home screen, preventing silent rollback to the previous slot.
- SD card font cache files are protected from OTA partition writes, fixing garbled text after some updates.
- Remove the misleading Settings OTA message that reported confirmation failed when the new image was already running.

## Firmware assets

- Stable builds ship as `waveshare-epaper-397-firmware.bin` with matching bootloader, partitions, boot_app0, manifests, and SHA-256 checksum files on GitHub Releases.
- Rolling tag `stable` carries the signed global and zh-CN manifests with embedded release notes for the OTA update screen.
- Normal stable OTA updates preserve books and reading data on the SD card.

## 中文摘要

- OTA 安装后在任一主页确认新固件，防止回滚到旧槽位。
- OTA 写入时保护 SD 卡字体缓存，修复安装完成后的乱码。
- 修正更新后误导性的“确认失败”提示。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dezzw/crossmux/compare/1.6.3...1.6.4
